programme.title: Borsalino & Co
programme.desc: 1974. Director: Jacques Deray. Stars Alain Delon, Riccardo Cucciolla & Daniel Ivernel. Francois Capela of the Marseilles' Mafia is being buried and his friend Roch Siffredi swears to avenge him. [S]

programme.title: Double X
programme.desc: 1992. Crime drama with Bernard Hill and Norman Wisdom. Former petty thief and safecracker Arthur is the 'brains' behind 'The Organisation' but he wants out. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life The Ball At His Feet
programme.desc: 1966. A look into what it takes to get to the top, and why football remains Britain's most popular sport. Contains lots of football stars from the clubs of the era.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Come Home Again. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. [S]

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: 1965. Viva Diaz!. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Cabin. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Mrs Mike
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Director: Louis King. Stars Dick Powell, Evelyn Keyes & J.M Kerrigan. Kathy O'Fallon meets Mountie Mike Flannigan. They fall in love, but can their love survive? [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the end of June and beginning of July. [S]

programme.title: Night Train for Inverness
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Stars Norman Wooland, Jane Hylton & Dennis Waterman. An ex-convict kidnaps his son and takes him on a train to Inverness, unaware he is putting his son's life in danger. [S]

programme.title: Blind Spot
programme.desc: 1958. Crime Drama directed by Peter Maxwell. Starring Robert Mackenzie, Michael Caine and Delphi Lawrence. US Officer Adams, blinded during the war, is framed on a diamond-smuggling rap. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Stuart Gilmore. Stars Dennis Morgan & Harry Shannon. On the bloody trail of a notorious gold robber, a ranger organises a posse, unaware that one member isn't what he seems. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Dutiful Murderer. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Peter Sallis. Cork criticises a friend of different culture. After the pair clash his friends daughter is found dead. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Ruby of Radnor. 1957. Stars: William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. As punishment Squire Brian is sent on an errand delivering a crate of pigeons to a neighbouring castle. [S]

programme.title: They Call It Murder
programme.desc: 1971. Director: Walter Grauman. Stars Jim Hutton, Lloyd Bochner & Jo Ann Pflug. An attorney's saddled with several major investigations, including a gambler's murder and a possible insurance scam. [S]

programme.title: Ring of Spies
